result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business, my top recommendation is **Xero**, particularly if you're operating in Australia.

It's user-friendly, automates much of your bookkeeping, connects to your bank and makes managing GST and BAS considerably easier.

However, the best choice depends on the type of business you run.

## My top 5 accounting software choices

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall for Australia)

- Easy to use and learn.
- Automatic bank feeds and reconciliation.
- GST, BAS and payroll capabilities.
- Excellent accountant integration.
  
  Best for: Most small businesses.
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and compliance)

- Australian-focused accounting.
- GST and BAS management.
- Strong payroll and employee management.
- Good inventory and job costing options.
  
  Best for: Businesses with employees.
  
  [MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Good financial reporting.
- Expense and invoice tracking.
- Useful business integrations.
- Scalable as your business grows.
  
  Best for: Small businesses wanting detailed financial reporting.
  
  [QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon**

- Competitive pricing.
- Australian GST and BAS features.
- Bank feeds and bookkeeping.
  
  Best for: Small businesses wanting to keep costs down.
  
  [Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good invoicing and expense management.
- Automation features.
- Free plan for eligible businesses.
  
  Best for: Startups and budget-conscious businesses.
  
  [Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

These recommendations reflect 2026 comparisons, including Australian tax and payroll requirements. [australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-accounting-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[stackpick.com.au](https://stackpick.com.au/best-accounting-software-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[thekalculators.com.au](https://thekalculators.com.au/best-accounting-software-small-business-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which one would I choose?

| Your business situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| General small business | Xero |
| Sole trader | Xero or Reckon |
| Business with employees | Xero or MYOB |
| Retail or inventory business | MYOB |
| Trades or contracting | Xero or MYOB |
| Lowest-cost option | Reckon or Zoho Books |


## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business
